description: Replace ceiling grid damaged by drywall lift, L2

email.subject: Summit - back-charges L2
email.body:
Marco,

Your crew's drywall lift damaged the ceiling grid on Level 2 at Summit. BC-4467: replace damaged
ceiling grid, L2, $6,800.00 per the Apex Ceilings invoice.

After three written warnings we hauled your debris ourselves. BC-4468: debris haul-off, $4,700.00.

Dana Ortiz, PM

clause.text: Contractor shall give Subcontractor written notice of any back-charge. Subcontractor shall have five (5) working days from receipt to dispute in writing. Undisputed back-charges may be deducted from any payment due Subcontractor.
